brief:
Ten Israeli soldiers have described killing unarmed Palestinians and falsely recording them as "terrorists" during Israel's military operations in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The soldiers recounted incidents in which their units killed civilians without apparent military justification, according to accounts gathered by the outlet.

The soldiers' testimonies suggest a pattern of misclassifying dead civilians in official records. Their accounts add to growing documentation of potential war crimes during the conflict in Gaza.

title: Israeli soldiers describe killing unarmed Palestinians in Gaza
